## Verification

- [ ] Rust formatting, tests, and strict Clippy pass, or are not applicable

## Privacy and dependencies

- [ ] No secrets, phone numbers, messages, precise private locations, device identifiers, databases, or private URLs are included
- [ ] Dependency updates respect the 48-hour cooldown and contain no unreviewed lifecycle scripts
- [ ] WhatsApp changes fail closed without recorded recipient opt-in
